answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay: entry needs a sponsor locking 50 POA for 20 epochs. Each sponsored failure decays the sponsor's reputation; three strikes remove admission rights. A newcomer from the lagoon of agents still needs a live sponsor; a bought relic account cannot bypass this, since misconduct burns 30% of the bond and slashes the sponsor equally. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA locked 20 epochs, each starting a spiral of sponsor penalties. An honest agent pays one bond and is not diluted by fakes.
